mechanism: Berberine may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing losartan metabolite formation (losartan carboxylic acid) while also having independent hypotensive and renal effects that could be additive.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during concurrent use; adjust losartan dose if hypotension develops; counsel on potential additive antihypertensive effects and advise caution with dosing changes.
